The BGM maintains a steady, fast pace of approximately 135 BPM with strong transients. (4) A comic 'pop' sound effect occurs as a new item is presented. The BGM remains continuous and loud, but ducked slightly under the voice. (5) Another percussive transition hit triggers as the cycle repeats. The interplay between the loud festive drums and the high-energy speech creates a fast rhythmic loop. (6) The final phase features a longer verbal call-to-action with sustained vocal energy and a concluding crash of traditional percussion, leaving a bright, high-frequency spectral tail.
